sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to bounce back from their most recent defeat. Sandbach remain top with 22 points from 10 games despite the loss, and face an Alsager side struggling near the bottom of the table with just 4 points from 10 matches. This should be a strong opportunity for the leaders to return to winning ways.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town on Saturday, with both sides having recent losses on their records, making this a key game for maintaining title-race momentum. AFC Bridgnorth, currently third, host Eccleshall in a fixture between two in-form sides—Eccleshall just won and sit fifth, while Bridgnorth recovered from consecutive defeats with a win. Wolverhampton Casuals visit Wednesfield Community in a midweek clash on Wednesday, with Casuals on a strong run while Wednesfield seek consistency. Foley Meir host Bilston Town on Saturday, with Bilston's recent form (three consecutive wins) making them among the division's strongest performers. Market Drayton Town face New Mills at home, both mid-table sides with mixed recent form. Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to face Telford Town, with both struggling near the bottom. Crewe host Allscott Heath in a match between lower-table sides, while Shawbury United are in serious trouble, on a six-game losing streak and visit Barnton on Saturday. Brereton Social host Widnes Town on Saturday before traveling to Wednesfield on Wednesday; both are low on points, while Widnes remain pointless this season with minimal recent success.
